summary_en: Beact Capital株式会社 to acquire 18,100 shares (18.1% of shares outstanding) from founder/CEO Yoshisuke Fujiwara on June 15, 2025. Fujiwara retains 50,000 shares (50.0% S/O) as largest shareholder. Beact Capital will become second-largest shareholder. Beact Capital represents a new investment vehicle (Beact Capital K.K.), capitalized at ¥300,000, with Fujiwara as representative director. No material impact on company performance expected; Beact Capital to hold shares long-term as stable shareholder.
title_en: Notice regarding a regulatory stock acquisition equivalent to a public tender offer and material change in principal shareholders of ACTBE Inc. (Stock Code 439A)
translation_en_brief: On June 15, 2025, founder and CEO Yoshisuke Fujiwara notified ACTBE Inc. that he intends to transfer 18,100 shares (18.1% of shares outstanding) to Beact Capital K.K., a newly formed investment company with Fujiwara as representative director and capitalized at ¥300,000. The acquisition constitutes a "regulatory-mandated stock acquisition equivalent to a public tender offer" under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act (Article 167(1) and Ordinance Article 31), as it results in a 5%+ voting-rights acquisition. Post-transfer, Fujiwara retains 50,000 shares (50.0% S/O) and remains the largest shareholder, while Beact Capital becomes the second-largest shareholder. Beact Capital is described as a securities holding and management company domiciled in Osaka. The company stated no material impact on operational performance is expected, with Beact Capital expected to hold shares long-term as a stable shareholder.
